title: Rory and the Starry Blossom Hill
verses:
The evening was falling across the wide hill,
The shadows grew cozy and deep,
The valley below became foggy and still,
As Rory was ready for sleep.

Then Benny leaned down with a velvety sigh,
To rest by a silvery mound,
While Nia flew down from the lavender sky,
And landed with hardly a sound.

And Tilly rolled over a carpet of moss,
To gather the blossoms that gleam,
While Ricky laid ribbons of petals across,
The bed for a wonderful dream.

High up in the branches, Psittaco took rest,
Tucked under a broad leafy dome,
To snuggle right down in a clover-lined nest,
And cuddle as safe as at home.

Then Rory curled softly beside all his friends,
And let out a slumbery yawn,
The hush of the evening so sweetly descends,
To cuddle them all until dawn.

The starlight glowed gently above in the blue,
A lullaby floated along,
The night-petals closed in the shimmering dew,
And whispered a sleepy night song.
